div.head: VIII Atr 1
div.ab: Þæt is ærest, þæt he wile, þæt ealle Godes circan beon fulles griðes wurðe.
Ðæt is ærest, þæt he wile, þæt ealle Godes cyrican beon fulles griðes wyrðe.
Þæt is ærest, þæt he wile þæt ealle Godes circan beon fulles griðes wurðe.
Þæt is ærest, þæt he wile, þæt ealle Godes circan beon fulles griðes wurðe.
Nämlich erstens, dass er will, dass alle Gotteskirchen vollen Sonderfrieden geniessen.
1. Namely, first, that he wills that all God's churches be entitled to full protection.
In the first place, it is his will that all the churches of God be entitled to exercise their right of protection to the full.
First, namely, that it is his will that all God’s churches are to be entitled to full right of sanctuary.
First, he desires that all God’s churches be entitled to offer full sanctuary.

note.seg: Die Kapitel 1—5, 2 bilden Einen Abschnitt; nur ihn bietet Hs. G; I Cn 2, 3—3, 2 übernimmt ihn im Zusammenhang.—Zu wörtlich: ‘Das ist das erste was er will’ Schmid; vgl. Wb S. 217 Z. 1
Chapters 1—5, 2 form a single section; MS G gives only this; I Cn 2, 3—3, 2 takes it over as a connected whole.—Too literal: ‘That is the first that he wills’ Schmid; cf. Wb p. 217 l. 1
Cf. E. and G. 1; II Edg. 1; VI Atr. 14. The first section of the ordinance—the only part which is found in G—begins here and ends with cap. 5, 2; cf. I Cn. 2, 3–3, 2.
